people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
translations.bsb: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
translations.asv: Jesus therefore said unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will in no wise believe.
